description: Endpoint definitions: names, time origins, censoring rules and known biases. Design information, not data. PUBLIC by construction — every value lives in the locked partitions and none appears here. Split out of test_partition_manifest.json so that the pre-registration gate needs no exception to the locked-path rule.
readable_by: pipeline/preregister.py (to copy a definition into a prereg) and pipeline/analysis/confirmatory.py. Generation-zone agents have no reason to read it and gain nothing from it — it contains no outcome values.

endpoint_registry.label: Overall survival
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index date to death from any cause; censored at last known contact.
endpoint_registry.censoring: administrative at data cutoff; last contact otherwise
known_biases: Left truncation at sequencing date — risk set must be entered at days_dx_to_sequencing, not at diagnosis.

endpoint_registry.label: Time to treatment discontinuation
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to permanent discontinuation of the index regimen or death.
known_biases: Discontinuation for toxicity is conflated with discontinuation for progression.

endpoint_registry.label: Time to next treatment
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to start of the subsequent line or death.
known_biases: Patients who leave the health system are censored informatively.

endpoint_registry.label: Radiology-assessed progression-free survival
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to NLP-extracted radiology progression or death.
known_biases: NLP progression extraction is imperfect; assessment intervals are non-uniform (informative censoring).
